readerCopy.body: The people demanding verifiable reform face a movement held together by a powerful but loosely defined vision. One side points to systems, tools, and changes that can be tested; the other points to imagination, solidarity, and a future that cannot yet be measured by the old rules. Uranus gives the break from convention practical force, while Neptune gives the collective ideal emotional reach. The opposition places disruptive evidence across from sustaining belief without allowing either to claim the future alone. The movement may continue, but the conflict reveals whether its technology serves the vision or simply gives confusion a faster route.
